    🏔 Meteorologist Forecast
    Temira, The Gorge Is My Gym · posted Fri Nov 6 · full post ↗

    Friday and Saturday will be too warm for snow. We’ll see a burst of rain Saturday night followed by a transition to snow after midnight. If we get really, really lucky, orographic (terrain-enhanced) assistance will give us 2-5” at 5000′ as the snow level falls to 4000′. By Tuesday, the snow level will be back around 10,000′, and no snow is expected between then and the 13th. Beyond the 13th, uncertainty is quite high – the forecast for temps at 5000′ ranges from -1C to +3C every day, which probably means the snow level will be bouncing around a lot and timing differences haven’t resolved. So, just cross your fingers and keep up the pre-season training program!

    Coming up on the 7th, there’s the annual Gorge Winter Gear Swap at Hood River Valley High School on Saturday, November 7th. 8Am early admission ($25), and 9am regular admission ($5/person, $10/family). On the same day, but from 4-6pm, there’s the Nordic Gear Swap at Working Hands Brewery in Hood River. It’s time to get new-used gear or sell your old stuff!
